name: proofbundle-house
description: The house marketplace of b7n0de for proofbundle-guard, added from a local checkout of b7n0de/proofbundle on the owner's machines. The public marketplace at the repository root lists proofbundle alone.

plugins.name: proofbundle-guard
plugins.description: Guard Preview, the house profile of b7n0de: hooks before every Bash call and before supported writes, with the house's autonomous answer under Claude Code; a hook that cannot run blocks the call. Not for general use; install proofbundle from the public marketplace to verify.
